svg.title: RV1103 dynamic-occlusion checkpoints and all-event LiDAR sector evidence
svg.desc: The map marks M1 through M8 without a route line. The evidence matrix reports left, center, and right near-sector excess for every R1 and R2 event at M2 through M7. A single non-zero sector remains visible when an event appears in only one sector. Black dots at M2 through M7 are evidence-derived schematic projections of the strongest recorded sector response at each marker, not raw LiDAR beam endpoints.
svg.text: L/C/R = excess near returns vs 1 s baseline (range 0.30–0.80 m).
0.05 m/pixel · finalized source telemetry · maximum event-window position drift 0.050 m
